```{=html}
<div class="va-sec" id="other-works-section"><h2>Other works</h2></div>

    <div>
      <h3 class="ow-title"><a href="https://www.constituteproject.org/constitution/Chile_2023DD">Chile 2023 &mdash; Draft of 30 Oct 2023</a></h3>
      <div class="ow-meta">

      </div>
      <div class="ow-note">Translation of the Chilean constitutional proposal</div>
      <div class="va-pubtags">
        <span class="va-pubtag listing-category" data-cat="Chile">Chile</span>
        <span class="va-pubtag listing-category" data-cat="Constitutional design">Constitutional design</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="other-works-empty" class="listing-no-matching" style="display: none;">No matching items</div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  // Quarto's listing script (1.4+) stores each sidebar category as base64 of its
  // URI-encoded name, and quartoListingCategory() expects that same encoding.
  // These hand-written entries carry plain names, so convert at the boundary.
  function encodeCat(name) { return btoa(encodeURIComponent(name)); }
  function decodeCat(raw) {
    if (!raw) return '';
    try { return decodeURIComponent(atob(raw)); } catch (e) { return raw; }
  }
  function syncOtherWorks() {
    var active = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-category .category.active');
    var cat = active ? decodeCat(active.dataset.category) : '';
    var entries = document.querySelectorAll('#other-works-list .va-otherwork');
    var empty = document.getElementById('other-works-empty');
    var anyVisible = false;
    entries.forEach(function (el) {
      var cats = (el.dataset.categories || '').split(',').map(function (s) { return s.trim(); });
      var show = !cat || cats.indexOf(cat) !== -1;
      el.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
      if (show) anyVisible = true;
    });
    if (empty) empty.style.display = (cat && !anyVisible) ? '' : 'none';
  }
  function updateSidebarCounts() {
    var entries = document.querySelectorAll('#other-works-list .va-otherwork');
    var bumps = {};
    entries.forEach(function (el) {
      (el.dataset.categories || '').split(',').forEach(function (raw) {
        var c = raw.trim();
        if (!c) return;
        bumps[c] = (bumps[c] || 0) + 1;
      });
    });
    var total = entries.length;
    document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-listing-category .category').forEach(function (el) {
      var raw = el.dataset.category || '';
      // The empty category is "All"; every other one is looked up by name.
      var add = raw === '' ? total : (bumps[decodeCat(raw)] || 0);
      var countEl = el.querySelector('.quarto-category-count');
      if (!add || !countEl) return;
      var n = parseInt(countEl.textContent.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''), 10) || 0;
      countEl.textContent = '(' + (n + add) + ')';
    });
  }
  function start() {
    updateSidebarCounts();
    syncOtherWorks();
    document.querySelectorAll('#other-works-list .va-pubtag[data-cat]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (window.quartoListingCategory) window.quartoListingCategory(encodeCat(el.dataset.cat));
      });
    });
    var sidebar = document.querySelector('.quarto-listing-category');
    if (sidebar) {
      new MutationObserver(syncOtherWorks).observe(sidebar, {
        attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'], subtree: true
      });
    }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start);
  } else {
    start();
  }
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Research-listing abstracts: clamp long descriptions to a few lines (count set
// by .va-pubblurb.is-clamped in CSS) and add a "Read more"/"Read less" toggle.
// Progressive enhancement: the full text is always in the DOM, so no-JS users
// lose nothing, and the toggle is added only when the text actually overflows.
(function () {
  function setup() {
    var blurbs = document.querySelectorAll('.research-listing .va-pubblurb');
    blurbs.forEach(function (el) {
      // Idempotency guard (in case this runs more than once).
      if (el.nextElementSibling &&
          el.nextElementSibling.classList.contains('va-readmore')) return;
      // Clamp, then measure: if the full text fits within the clamp, leave it
      // expanded with no button; otherwise keep it clamped and add a toggle.
      el.classList.add('is-clamped');
      if (el.scrollHeight <= el.clientHeight + 1) {
        el.classList.remove('is-clamped');
        return;
      }
      var btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.type = 'button';
      btn.className = 'va-readmore';
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'va-readmore-label';
      label.textContent = 'Read more';
      var caret = document.createElement('span');
      caret.className = 'va-readmore-caret';
      caret.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      // Empty on purpose: the triangle is drawn in CSS (.va-readmore-caret),
      // which also flips it when expanded.
      btn.appendChild(label);
      btn.appendChild(caret);
      el.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', btn);
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var clamped = el.classList.toggle('is-clamped');
        label.textContent = clamped ? 'Read more' : 'Read less';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', clamped ? 'false' : 'true');
      });
    });
  }
  // Measure after web fonts settle so line metrics are accurate; fall back to
  // DOMContentLoaded / immediate when the Font Loading API is unavailable.
  function schedule() {
    if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
      document.fonts.ready.then(setup);
    } else {
      setup();
    }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', schedule);
  } else {
    schedule();
  }
})();
</script>
```
